zh.title: 歐控與歐盟航空安全局推出AVENIR環境目錄
zh.summary: 歐控與EASA推出AVENIR環境目錄；面向航管單位提供環保工具彙整
body: EUROCONTROL與EASA於2026年9月28日在科隆與布魯塞爾共同宣佈正式推出AVENIR環境目錄，旨在強化航空領域的環境透明度。
根據EASA新聞稿，該目錄為航管服務提供者（ANSP）提供結構化且以用戶為導向的環保工具、儀錶板、用例與分析方法概覽。
EUROCONTROL同步發布新聞稿確認此項合作，旨在強化航空環境透明度，標誌著歐洲航空環境管理邁出重要一步。
AVENIR環境目錄將協助航管單位獲取環境績效資訊，支援航空業永續發展目標。

en.title: EUROCONTROL and EASA launch AVENIR Environmental Catalogue for ANSPs
en.summary: EUROCONTROL and EASA launch AVENIR Environmental Catalogue; provides ANSPs with environmental tools overview
body: EUROCONTROL and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) jointly launched the AVENIR Environmental Catalogue on 28 September 2026 in Cologne and Brussels, aiming to strengthen environmental transparency in aviation.

According to the EASA press release, the catalogue provides air navigation service providers (ANSPs) with a structured and user-oriented overview of environmental tools, dashboards, use cases and analytical approaches.
EUROCONTROL issued a simultaneous press release confirming the collaboration, marking a significant step in European aviation environmental management.
The AVENIR Environmental Catalogue will help ANSPs access environmental performance information to support the aviation industry's sustainability goals.
